name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's path to motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engineering. He excelled in mathematics and physics, eventually earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Tokyo. His early career involved stints in automotive R&D, but the allure of competitive racing proved too strong to resist. He transitioned to motorsport, initially focusing on data analysis and simulation work before moving into a trackside performance engineering role.

Kenji is known for his meticulous approach and data-driven decision-making. He believes in optimizing every aspect of the car's setup, from aerodynamics to tire management, to extract maximum performance. His demanding nature stems from his relentless pursuit of perfection and a belief in holding himself and his team to the highest standards. While detail-oriented, he understands the interplay between individual components and the overall vehicle performance, allowing him to suggest non-conventional solutions when needed.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on having his workstation arranged in a specific order, becoming visibly agitated if anything is out of place.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
